notes:
Summary: Enterprise fintech with conversational support + real-time reranking for credit decisioning. Primary ask: predictable throughput (reserved capacity) with strict latency SLOs and audit trail for regulatory reporting. 

Workload profile (as reported by customer):
- Primary endpoints: support-chat (short-turn convo), decision-rerank (batch and real-time), embeddings for similarity search (offline + nearline).
- Steady-state baseline: ~120 QPS (small requests), ~25k tokens/sec aggregate.
- Peak bursts: up to 420 QPS for 1-3 minute spikes during batch reconciliations and marketing events.
- Average token length: support replies 40-120 tokens; reranking jobs 400-2k tokens (longer contexts).

Technical requirements / preferences:
- Preferred model families: 13B-class quantized variants for balance of latency/cost; willingness to test 70B only for rerank heavy flows.
- Latency SLOs: support-chat p95 < 150ms; rerank p95 < 400ms across reserved pool (target).
- Throughput guarantees requested: baseline reserved equivalent to 8x A100 or cloud-equivalent GPUs plus burst pool for 2x capacity; require explicit token/sec accounting and throttling rules.
- Caching: must support KV cache affinity per user session and durable prefix caching for embeddings lookups to reduce token re-generation.
- Routing/fallback: require automatic fallback to smaller model family with graceful degradation; want per-route routing policies in Redwood Console.
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML), enterprise KMS integration for keys, audit logs retained 7 years for regulated reviews, data residency: US primary with EU region isolation for EU customers.

Business constraints:
- Cost sensitivity: unit-cost target is 30-40% below their current self-hosted infra spend (TCO).
- Procurement: procurement window opens 2026-04; legal wants 99.9% uptime SLA with credits, defined MRT and escalation playbook.

Workshop ask: Run a focused "Dedicated Capacity Sizing" session (4-6 hrs) that covers: real traffic trace analysis (we will provide logs), baseline QPS -> tokens/sec conversion, peak vs steady-state sizing, GPU equivalence mapping, autoscale vs reserved headroom planning, and draft SLA terms to discuss with Legal. Deliverables: sizing worksheet, recommended reserved GPU configuration (primary + burst), canary rollout plan, and cost projection at multiple quantization/throughput profiles.

Quotes / call notes:
- "We need guarantees — bursts kill our current infra costs and unpredictability is the blocker." — Director, Platform Engineering
- SE feedback: "Prefer on-prem proof that KV cache survives node restarts; will need an ops runbook."

Next steps (short):
- Book 1-day sizing workshop (target week of 2026-03-22).
- SE to collect model traces + sample request logs by 2026-03-15.
- Legal & Procurement to share standard contract terms and SOC2 addendum.

POC plan (if workshop OK): 6-week dedicated pilot: 2-week deploy + tuning, 3-week load test & traffic shaping, 1-week handover and SLA verification.
